name: Mag-Float Glass Cleaner
description: A floating two-piece magnet cleaner — you wipe green-spot + film algae off the inner glass from outside the tank, no wet hands. Honest targets: it shears soft film + green-spot off the flat glass but can't reach the irregular surfaces of hardscape. effectiveness (0.65) + reachMm (90) are MODELLED game-tuning weights, not product specs.
notes: Sand-safe variants exist, but grit trapped between the pads scratches glass — lift it off the substrate, never drag it through sand.
